duration.value: 1 round/level (up to 5 rounds)  DESCRIPTION This ninjutsu suppresses any sound made by the ninja. The ninja cannot be heard from outside sources during this ninjutsus effect. This includes attacking, moving, and speaking. This doesn’t hinder the ninja from casting ninjutsus that require verbal components.
